brand_guidelines.mission: Making organic food accessible to every family
brand_guidelines.vision: A world where healthy eating is the easy choice
brand_guidelines.brand_promise: We make eating organic convenient, affordable, and trustworthy.
key_messages: Know exactly where your food comes from
Organic doesn't have to be complicated
Good for you. Good for the planet.

psychographics.values_driven: Environmental sustainability is a purchase driver

pain_points: Don't know which brands to trust
No time to research food sources
aspirations: Feed family healthy meals without stress

tone_of_voice.voice_characteristics: A friendly nutritionist neighbor who makes healthy living feel achievable, not overwhelming.

tone_variations.formal: For sustainability reports — data-driven, transparent, authoritative
tone_variations.casual: For social media — warm, uses emojis naturally, speaks like a friend
tone_variations.urgent: For limited harvests — excitement about freshness, seasonal availability
tone_variations.empathetic: For overwhelmed parents — reassuring, practical, celebrates small wins

do_say: Know your farmer. Know your food.
Fresh from the farm to your table

visual_identity.logo_usage: Leaf icon should always face right. Minimum clear space equals the width of the leaf. Use white on green backgrounds, full-color on white or light backgrounds.
visual_identity.imagery_style: Natural lighting photos of real farms and families. Warm, earthy tones. Unfiltered, authentic food photography. Avoid sterile studio shots.
